storyLines: You look so ... ALIVE... It freaks me out!
Our school's already in trouble because of those bastards.
Huh? Why do I do nothing about it though?
^<font=CROOKED>^THEY DON'T EVEN KNOW I EXIST IN THE FIRST PLACE.
Now I'm tired. When's the teacher coming...
(She did not speak anymore as she was asleep.)
